name: omlx
description: LLM inference server with continuous batching & SSD caching for Apple Silicon — managed from the macOS menu bar
readmeExcerpt:
oMLX

LLM inference, optimized for your Mac
Continuous batching and tiered KV caching, managed directly from your menu bar.

junkim.dot@gmail.com · https://omlx.ai/me

Install · Quickstart · Features · Models · CLI Configuration · Benchmarks · oMLX.ai

English · 中文 · 한국어 · 日本語

---

> *Every LLM server I tried made me choose between convenience and control. I wanted to pin everyday models in memory, auto-swap heavier ones on demand, set context limits - and manage it all from a menu bar.* > > *oMLX persists KV cache across a hot in-memory tier and cold SSD tier - even when context changes mid-conversation, all past context stays cached and reusable across requests, making local LLMs practical for real coding work with tools like Claude Code. That's why I built it.* ## Install ### macOS App Download the `.dmg` from [Releases](https://github.com/jundot/omlx/releases), drag to Applications, done. The app includes in-app auto-update, so future upgrades are just one click. The macOS app also installs a lightweight `~/.omlx/bin/omlx` CLI shim so terminal commands and Apple Shortcuts can control the app-managed server. ### Homebrew ```bash brew tap jundot/omlx https://github.com/jundot/omlx brew install jundot/omlx/omlx # Upgrade to the latest version brew update && brew upgrade omlx # Run as a background service (auto-restarts on crash) omlx start # Optional: MCP (Model Context Protocol) support /opt/homebrew/opt/omlx/libexec/bin/pip install mcp ``` Optional GLM-5.2 / MiniMax M3 native custom kernels currently require a HEAD build

analysis.oneLine: omlx 是一个面向 AI 编程工作流的规则与提示词资产，适合用于提升 Claude Code 或同类编码 Agent 的执行稳定性。
analysis.problem: AI 编程工具容易在上下文、测试、回滚和任务边界上犯重复错误，需要可复用的工程约束
analysis.audience: 使用 AI 编程的开发者、技术负责人、希望建立团队级 AI 编码规范的小团队
detailParagraphs: omlx 更准确地说是一个面向 AI 编程工作流的规则与提示词资产，而不是一个只因为短期热度上榜的仓库。对国内用户来说，判断重点不应停留在 README 的自我描述，而要看它是否能解决一个真实、可复用、可持续维护的工作流问题：AI 编程工具容易在上下文、测试、回滚和任务边界上犯重复错误，需要可复用的工程约束。
如果把它放进实际使用场景，omlx 的价值主要来自提升 Claude Code 或同类编码 Agent 的执行稳定性。当前 Star 约 20,546，说明它已经具备一定社区关注度，但商业用户更需要继续验证三件事：是否能嵌入现有业务流程，是否能由团队基于 Python 技术栈持续维护，以及是否能形成稳定交付而不是一次性 Demo。
从商业化和私有化角度看，它更像知识资产而非软件系统，价值在于能否转化为团队开发规范、评审清单或定制化 Agent 工作流。无需复杂部署，但需要根据团队技术栈、代码规范和安全要求改写后才能稳定使用。当前最需要警惕的是：风险在于规则泛化过度，直接复制可能不适合本地项目；需要结合真实仓库测试迭代。因此建议先用一个小范围真实任务做部署测试，再决定它适合作为内部工具、客户方案组件，还是仅作为趋势观察样本。
